name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is added latency—depth estimation slows the pipeline—but the quality gain outweighs the delay for most use cases.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers like InstantX-ComfyUI won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because they prioritize geometric accuracy over identity preservation—faces are high-frequency detail, not depth cues. RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler already locks EXCAVA into Anthropic’s stack, so swapping tools won’t break that dependency. To settle this, run a blind A/B test: compare InstantX’s output against RealVisXL’s face mode on 50 EXCAVA faces—if InstantX’s faces score worse in a user study, drop it.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline now. It locks identity better than depth-aware upscalers, which matters most for EXCAVA’s core output—faces. The trade-off is compute cost: RealVisXL 5.0 needs a dedicated GPU node, but the face fidelity gain justifies the spend.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler doesn’t solve EXCAVA’s core problem—it just masks it with Anthropic’s proprietary stack, locking us into a single vendor’s costs and update cycles. A better alternative is testing the new FLUX-dev model’s face fidelity with a lightweight upscaler like SwinIR, which preserves identity without Anthropic’s GPU tax; settle the argument by running a blind A/B test on 100 face-heavy samples and measuring both fidelity and compute cost.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Add ComfyUI’s open-source FaceDetailer node with SD3.5’s face mode to EXCAVA’s pipeline now—it preserves identity without vendor lock-in, and SwinIR can handle upscaling separately.

Result must deliver: EXCAVA’s face fidelity improves by at least 0.5% with no added latency beyond current pipeline. Owned by Gearbox.
